sentences.en: The guy was so childish that he couldn't resist temptation.
sentences.zh: 这个家伙太孩子气了，抵挡不住诱惑。

sentences.en: "Why did you buy a new laptop?" "I couldn't resist!"
sentences.zh: "你为什么买了一台新笔记本？" "我抵挡不住啊！"

sentences.en: I can't resist a woman who knows what she wants.
sentences.zh: 我对想要什么都知道的女人无法抗拒。

mnemonic: re（始终）+sist（坐）→始终以静坐抵抗
